Eroge Sekai ni Tensei Shita Ore ga, Oshi e no Ai de Netorare Heroine o Shiawase ni Suru. (エロゲ世界に転生した俺が、推しへの愛で寝取られヒロインを幸せにする。, lit. I, Who Was Reincarnated into the World of Eroge, Will Make the NTR Heroine Happy with My Love., abbrev. TenHero) is an ongoing Japanese web comic, written by Mizuki Mizushiro and illustrated by Satsuki Asha. It's being serialized in Comipo since July 13, 2023, with four Volumes released as of January 2026.

The story follows Mitsuki, a college students who gets roped by a friend into playing an erotic game, Hanaguri, and promptly falls head over heels in love with the game's main heroine, Kotoha... But, the harsh truth is that he has been duped: Hanaguri is a NTR game disguised as a pure-love dating game, in which all the heroines are seduced by the player's best friend, Ryou.
While searching for a happy ending with Kotoha, Mitsuki accidentally falls onto the train platform. When he wakes up, he finds himself reincarnated as Kouki, the player character of Hanaguri!
With his vast knowledge of the game, and deep love for Kotoha, Mitsuki is determined to change fate this time.
In order to protect Kotoha and the others from Ryou, he must achieve a perfect happy ending.

Good news! To celebrate Kotoha's birthday, all chapters of TenHero were available for free for 24 hours... and I took the chance to download them all.
These are all the chapters of TenHero published to date. When new chapters are released (Two new chapters are released monthly), I’ll post them here.
